answer: Each new identity locks a 40-credit copper bond in escrow and posts its referrer on a public graph, so a tide of fakes leaves one star: one referrer, hundreds of referrals. Any peer can dispute a cluster; a proven fake loses its bond and slashes its referrer too. One hundred fakes cost 4,000 credits against 120 earned per epoch, a 33-epoch payback no attacker accepts. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps its income whole in an ocean of agents.
